newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein easier, awaits PORLA.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein easier, awaits PORLA.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were easier in early trading on Monday, with players keeping to the sidelines as they waited for official Malaysian crop data.

They said palm olein was mostly quoted at 1,380-85 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, against 1,385-90 rupiah at last Friday's close, but trades were also heard at 1,375 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,176 rupiah/kg exBelawan at a tender last Thursday.

"The market is slow because most players are waiting for crop data from PORLA (Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority) to be announced today," one trader said. "We will see some activity if the numbers are market friendly."
